_note: Midjourney automation configuration. Edit this file to point at your Discord setup.

discord._note_channelUrl: The Discord channel URL where the Midjourney bot lives. Defaults to DM with MJ bot. Replace with your server's channel URL.

chrome._note_userDataDir: Chrome profile directory. The user must sign into Discord in this profile ONCE, then reuse it. A fresh profile starts logged-out.

mj._note_defaultArgs: Default Midjourney parameters appended when the prompt file doesn't specify --ar, --style, etc.
mj._note_generationTimeoutMs: Max time to wait for MJ to finish generating (milliseconds). MJ 4-up grids typically take 30-90s.

paths._note_chromeBin: Path to Chrome executable. Override if using Brave, Edge, etc.
